description: Browse question pages in this knowledge base without a search query. Filter by section (education, how-to, science, geography, popular, 2026, markets, news), grade (for education pages, e.g. '1' or 'k'), subject (e.g. 'math'), or category (e.g. 'units', 'money', 'physics', 'capitals', a markets topic such as 'fed-funds-rate', or a news topic such as 'us'). Results are paginated. Use list_sections first to see available filters and counts. Read-only.
